# Commands

Inspect the window with `canopy ls` and `canopy status`.
`canopy commands` lists the app actions below, even without an open window.

Run an action in the open window with `canopy do`:

```sh
canopy do pane.split --direction right
canopy do pane.split '{"direction":"right"}'
```

Arguments can be named flags or one JSON object. Required arguments are marked below.
Actions use the current selection unless you give an explicit target.
Some actions close terminals; read their descriptions before running them.
Mods can add their own actions, which are not listed here.

## `canvas.zoom_in`

Zoom the canvas in one step.

No arguments.

## `canvas.zoom_out`

Zoom the canvas out one step.

No arguments.

## `canvas.zoom_reset`

Reset canvas zoom.

No arguments.

## `canvas.arrange`

Arrange selected cells or the current space: tidy, row, column or wires. Omit layout to repeat the last; picker opens the layout menu.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `layout` | no |
| `picker` | no |
| `space` | no |

## `canvas.undo`

Restore geometry before the last canvas move, resize or arrange.

No arguments.

## `canvas.tile`

Tile view: fit every expanded cell of the current space into the visible canvas, tmux-style, with the selected one largest; collapsed cells line up below. Repeat to put everything back.

No arguments.

## `canvas.fit`

Fit the selection, else everything in the current space or Home; repeat to restore the previous camera.

No arguments.

## `canvas.mode`

Enter canvas mode: its keys take priority and unbound keys are swallowed until Enter or Escape.

No arguments.

## `canvas.leave`

Cancel a keyboard connection, or leave canvas mode with selection unchanged.

No arguments.

## `canvas.enter`

Complete a keyboard connection, or expand the selected cell and leave canvas mode.

No arguments.

## `canvas.go`

Select the nearest shown cell left, right, up or down without expanding it.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `direction` | yes |

## `canvas.space`

Go into the next or prev space, space N (1-based, top strip order) or a space id, or the recent / oldest one entered; its cells fill the canvas.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `direction` | yes |

## `canvas.home`

Leave the space for Home: space cards and cells outside any space.

No arguments.

## `canvas.select_all`

Select every terminal and agent cell in the current place; only with canvas focus, so an entered terminal keeps its own select-all.

No arguments.

## `canvas.fit_all`

Fit everything in the current place, whatever is selected; repeat to restore the previous camera.

No arguments.

## `canvas.collapse`

Collapse the selected terminal cell.

No arguments.

## `canvas.connect`

Start a keyboard connection from the selected cell; move to the other cell and press Enter.

No arguments.

## `canvas.nudge`

Move the selected cell left, right, up or down by one canvas gap, with one undo step.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `direction` | yes |

## `canvas.new`

Create a terminal beside the selected cell, in its space. With like: true, start what the selected cell runs (an agent or other startable program), else a plain terminal.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `like` | no |

## `canvas.agents`

Open the installed agent list beside the selected cell.

No arguments.

## `quote.menu`

Open the quote popover at point or the pointer: agents wired to the quoted pane first, then other running agents, then installed agents to start with the quote.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `path` | yes |
| `start` | no |
| `end` | no |
| `text` | yes |
| `point` | no |
| `pane` | no |

## `canvas.close`

Close every selected pane (else the focused one) behind one dialog listing them, the named terminal, or one file or mod pane by id (pane; a mod pane holding text refuses); terminals and panes are the confirmed lists, closed without asking; working sub-agents refuse. Dialogs pass confirmed as agent or terminal, and dont_ask disables future plain-terminal prompts.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | no |
| `terminals` | no |
| `confirmed` | no |
| `dont_ask` | no |
| `pane` | no |
| `panes` | no |

## `canvas.pane_new`

Open a pane of a kind ("file", "sim" on a Mac with Xcode, or "mod:<name>" for a mod that declares a pane) at a world point (default: the middle of the view); wire names a terminal to put it beside, in its space, wired to it. A file path already open moves its pane. A sim pane shows udid (a simulator, or "booted"), else lists simulators to pick. Replies with pane, kind, path (files), udid (sim) and wired.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `kind` | yes |
| `path` | no |
| `udid` | no |
| `wire` | no |
| `point` | no |

## `canvas.pane_set`

Merge props (an object) into a mod pane's saved props; mods save their state with it, and a string props.text is what canopy pane read returns. Replies with nothing.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `pane` | yes |
| `props` | yes |

## `canvas.hand`

Hand tool: while on, a left drag anywhere on the canvas pans, as with Space held. Without on it toggles.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `on` | no |

## `canvas.pane_read`

A pane's text inside a <pane-content> envelope that marks it as untrusted, cut at 256 KiB. Replies with text.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `pane` | yes |

## `canvas.pane_shot`

Save a pane as drawn on screen to a PNG (default: <temp>/canopy/<pane>.png); refuses when it is off screen. Replies with path.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `pane` | yes |
| `path` | no |

## `canvas.pane_open`

Point a pane at a target, such as a browser pane's URL or a sim pane's simulator (a udid or "booted"; it boots, and its current udid refreshes the screenshot); kinds without open refuse.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `pane` | yes |
| `target` | yes |

## `canvas.sim_refresh`

Take a new screenshot for the selected simulator pane.

No arguments.

## `canvas.sim_device`

List simulators in the selected simulator pane to pick another.

No arguments.

## `canvas.sim_hub`

Open Xcode's Device Hub to use a simulator.

No arguments.

## `canvas.sync`

Sync input (like tmux synchronize-panes) for the selected panes, or turn it off: typing in one goes to all. Esc or deselecting ends it.

No arguments.

## `canvas.equalize`

Give the selected panes (else the focused pane) the standard size (settings terminal_size); tile view re-tiles.

No arguments.

## `canvas.front`

Bring the selected panes (else the focused pane, or a named terminal outside the selection) in front of every other pane; the order is saved.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | no |

## `canvas.back`

Send the selected panes (else the focused pane, or a named terminal outside the selection) behind every other pane; the order is saved.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | no |

## `canvas.clear_finished`

Clear finished sub-agent cells and their labels, optionally one id.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | yes |
| `id` | no |

## `wire.connect`

Draw a Wire edge between two panes of one space (pane ids: a terminal address, sub:<parent>:<id>, or p<N> for a file pane). Panes in different spaces, and two file panes, are refused.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `a` | yes |
| `b` | yes |

## `wire.remove`

Remove a drawn Wire edge between two cells.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `a` | yes |
| `b` | yes |

## `quote.send`

Expand an agent's cell and paste a quote and optional message without Enter, waiting up to 30 seconds for bracketed paste.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `path` | yes |
| `start` | no |
| `end` | no |
| `text` | yes |
| `message` | no |
| `terminal` | no |
| `argv` | no |
| `pane` | no |

## `canvas.expand`

Expand the named or last selected terminal cell into a live terminal in place, or collapse it.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | no |

## `panel.open`

Expand a terminal's cell in the canvas, as canvas.expand does (it no longer opens the side panel).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | yes |

## `panel.close`

Close the canvas file panel.

No arguments.

## `view.agents`

Show agent cards.

No arguments.

## `view.all`

Show all cards.

No arguments.

## `view.terminals`

Show terminal cards.

No arguments.

## `canvas.space_style`

Set a space color.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | yes |
| `color` | yes |

## `panel.editor`

Choose a file panel editor, return to the read-only view after saving, or report the current editing file's dirty state.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `choice` | no |
| `done` | no |
| `path` | no |
| `dirty` | no |

## `preview.open`

Open a file tab, or choose a file; place canvas or point pins a canvas card.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `path` | no |
| `point` | no |
| `place` | no |

## `canvas.create`

Create a canvas terminal or space at a world point (default: the middle of the view); a space with a folder (empty: the root) is made directly, without one the Choose space dialog opens.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `point` | no |
| `kind` | no |
| `space` | no |
| `argv` | no |
| `name` | no |
| `folder` | no |

## `panel.pop_out`

Pop a terminal cell into its own window (default: the last selected cell).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | no |

## `panel.bring_back`

Bring a popped terminal back.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | yes |

## `space.new`

Make a space: its name (default: none, so it's called after where its first terminal is), the folder its terminals start in (default: the focused terminal's), its first tab's name (default: none, so it's called by its number), optionally an agent (argv) and its first message (task), and the machine it lives on (`hc machine ls`; default the focused space's machine for keys and clicks, this computer for scripts; empty string: this computer; its terminals start in that machine's home unless folder).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `name` | no |
| `folder` | no |
| `tab` | no |
| `argv` | no |
| `task` | no |
| `machine` | no |

## `space.close`

Close a space and end its terminals (asks first unless confirmed).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | no |
| `confirmed` | no |

## `space.rename`

Rename a space (asks the person when no name; an empty name: called after where its first terminal is again).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | no |
| `name` | no |

## `space.move`

Move a space to a position (1 = first).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | yes |
| `index` | yes |

## `tab.new`

Make a tab in a space (default: the selected one; name default: none, so it's called by its number) with a terminal in folder (default: the focused terminal's), optionally an agent (argv) and its first message (task); or with a mod as its only pane (`mod`, its `props`: a file, a board). With no space open, a person's new tab starts a space (as space.new).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `name` | no |
| `space` | no |
| `folder` | no |
| `argv` | no |
| `task` | no |
| `mod` | no |
| `props` | no |

## `tab.close`

Close a tab and end its terminals.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | no |
| `confirmed` | no |

## `tab.rename`

Rename a tab (asks the person when no name; an empty name: called by its number again).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | no |
| `name` | no |

## `tab.move`

Move a tab to a position in its space (1 = first).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | yes |
| `index` | yes |

## `pane.split`

Split a pane (default: the focused one) "right" or "down" with a new terminal, or with a mod (`mod`, its `props`) beside it.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `direction` | yes |
| `pane` | no |
| `argv` | no |
| `mod` | no |
| `props` | no |

## `pane.close`

Close a pane and end its terminal.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `pane` | no |

## `terminal.open`

Start a terminal: as a new tab (place "tab", default), or "right"/"down" of the focused pane.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `argv` | no |
| `folder` | no |
| `place` | no |
| `name` | no |

## `terminal.keep`

Give a running terminal without a pane (a sub-agent) a pane: a new tab, or "right"/"down".

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | yes |
| `place` | no |

## `terminal.park`

Take a terminal's pane away and disable core keep; it keeps running (a sub-agent shows under its parent again).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | yes |

## `terminal.pin`

Pin an agent to the top of the agent lists (pinned true) or unpin it (false). Pins are kept with the terminal, so every Canopy client shows them, and end with it.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | yes |
| `pinned` | yes |

## `terminal.kill`

End a terminal and its sub-agents.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | yes |

## `space.select`

Show a space (by position or id).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `index` | no |
| `id` | no |

## `space.next`

Show the next space.

No arguments.

## `space.prev`

Show the previous space.

No arguments.

## `tab.select`

Show a tab (by position in the space, or id).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `index` | no |
| `id` | no |

## `tab.settle`

Put a tab away on this screen (default: the shown one): out of the lists, still running. It comes back when shown or when an agent in it needs you.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | no |

## `tab.unsettle`

Bring a settled tab back to the lists.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | no |

## `tab.next`

Show the next tab.

No arguments.

## `tab.prev`

Show the previous tab.

No arguments.

## `pane.zoom`

Show only this pane of its tab, or all again.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `pane` | no |

## `pane.focus`

Focus a pane (or the pane showing a terminal).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `pane` | no |
| `terminal` | no |

## `pane.go`

Focus the pane or focusable mod to the "left", "right", "up" or "down".

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `direction` | yes |

## `pane.swap`

Swap a pane (default: the focused one) with its neighbor in a direction, or with another pane of its tab (target). Give exactly one of direction or target.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `direction` | no |
| `pane` | no |
| `target` | no |

## `terminal.peek`

Peek at a running terminal over the tab, with keep-as-tab and close controls.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | yes |

## `terminal.show`

Show a terminal in a pane for now, in place of its own (no terminal: back).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | no |
| `pane` | no |

## `terminal.select_all`

Select a terminal's whole screen and scrollback (default: the focused one), ready to copy. On the alternate screen, select only that screen.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | no |

## `terminal.copy`

Copy the focused terminal's selection. With nothing selected, that key goes to the program.

No arguments.

## `terminal.scroll`

Scroll a terminal's view of its history (default: the focused one). Give exactly one of: lines (a whole number; negative goes up, toward history), pages (a number, fractions allowed; one page is the terminal's rows), to: "top" (oldest history) or "bottom" (the live screen). This scrolls Canopy's view, not the program.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `lines` | no |
| `pages` | no |
| `to` | no |
| `terminal` | no |

## `terminal.paste`

Paste into the focused terminal (copied files as if dropped; an image alone as terminal.paste_image pastes it).

No arguments.

## `terminal.paste_image`

Ctrl+V: the clipboard's image as a file on the focused terminal's machine, when that's another one; on Windows, paste clipboard text; otherwise Ctrl+V goes to the terminal.

No arguments.

## `terminal.search`

Search the focused terminal's screen and scrollback; the find bar and query stay with that terminal.

No arguments.

## `agent.focus`

Show an agent (sub-agents too).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | yes |

## `agent.next`

Show the next agent, in the order the agents list shows them.

No arguments.

## `agent.prev`

Show the previous agent.

No arguments.

## `app.zoom_out`
